domain.text: Delivery tooling for staging and submitting model-learning records through reviewed pull requests.

impressions.text: The worker implemented rolling learning-PR submissions, deduplication, ambiguity safeguards, and broad regression coverage; the worker reported 984 passing tests and green checks.
The orchestrator caught that a submission failure could incorrectly fail an already-recorded grade; the worker added a warning and regression test while preserving successful grading.

The implementation refuses ambiguous or moved learning-PR states, and failed automatic submission leaves the record staged with instructions to retry; live fork writes and merging were not performed by the worker.

roundCauses.text: Review round 1 requested that automatic learning-submission failures not cause `grade` to fail after the grade was saved and posted.
